about: Shot list for the homepage preview (scripts/capture-preview.mjs). Each segment opens Humanoid at a deep link, as a visitor would, and renders frames on its frame-stepped clock (?virt=1). Setup frames are simulated without drawing (__fabAdvance(n, false)).

segments.name: intro
segments.about: FO-H1 standing in the dark test lab, alive: balance sway, gaze, the slow camera.

segments.name: actuator
segments.about: The knee actuator slides out of the thigh and separates into its parts while running a walking duty cycle.

segments.name: walk
segments.about: Walking on the instrumented treadmill, ground reactions and the centre of mass shown.

segments.name: push
segments.about: A 300 N push: the capture point leaves the feet and a step catches it.
